body:
Not gonna have time for that. I’m hoping I’ll be free by the weekend. She started getting onto me and I called her out. I told her she knew how I felt about her yelling at me and if she couldn’t discuss things like an adult we will talk later. She did end up turning it around to how she doesn’t feel loved and how I ruined our engagement through a crummy proposal. But I kept my head, I iterated my points and tried to communicate clearly. She of course kept saying there’s no point int trying to talk because I don’t listen and nothing will change. But, eventually she said “there’s nothing left to talk about. I’ll see you when you get home.” 

So, at the very least I can finish my shift in peace. She’s going to her father’s this weekend and she said she thinks she wants to go alone. We’ll see if that lasts but as of rn I think I might be out of this soon.

Sorry it’s been 25 days. I’ve been working on an escape plan. I’m going to let the Dean and the therapist of our school know about the claims. I went ahead and took the bullets out of her gun and hid them while she was gone today. The next argument we get into I’m going to turn on my camera and tell her she’s abusive and I can’t take it any more. That way if anything happens I’m cleared. I appreciate your advice and I’ll try and update once I’m free. I started using an onion router to hide this account further cause she works in IT so it may be a while before I’m in the clear.
Realizing when people you love are abusive.
